stories.title: AfD Wins Historic Victory in State Election, But German Establishment May Hold Onto Power
stories.summary: Germany's far-right Alternative for Germany won a commanding first-place finish in the Saxony-Anhalt state election on Sunday, with exit polls projecting the party at over 44% of the vote, far ahead of the conservative CDU on 18.4%. Party leaders hailed the result as historic, though it remained unclear whether the AfD could form a government as other parties have ruled out coalition with them. The election could bring the first far-right state government to power in Germany's post-World War II history.

stories.title: CD sales are making an unexpected comeback amid a retro tech boom
stories.summary: Compact disc sales are experiencing an unexpected resurgence as younger consumers embrace physical media in what many analysts describe as a retro tech boom. The Verge and TechCrunch both reported on the trend, noting that CD sales in the US rose for the first time in decades, driven by Gen Z and millennial buyers seeking tangible ownership in an era of streaming subscriptions.

links.headline: CD sales are making an unexpected comeback amid a retro tech boom
links.excerpt: U.S. CD revenue jumped 58.6% in the first half of 2026, reversing last year’s decline as interest in retro tech and physical media continues to grow.
